factual_errors: Appendix A (pp. 14-15): 'the estimated error of each configuration would be biased downward by an amount proportional to its observed repeat disagreement' states the direction backwards. With a positive shared error fraction rho, E<d1 - r, d2 - r> = ||theta - r||^2 + rho*tr(Sigma), so the cross-repeat D is biased upward. painter_repeat_covariance_v1 correctly computes adjusted D = D - rho*q/(1 - rho).
